about_the_game:
Toad Turf is a thrilling party shooter supporting 4-16 players in free-for-all or team-based modes, playable via online or LAN with split-screen support throughout all options.

Players engage in fast-paced combat, wielding unique weapons, collecting wacky power-ups that shift the dynamics of each match, and dodging shots to stay alive. With platform-hopping action and intense firefights, Toad Turf offers an accessible yet exhilarating experience for both newcomers and seasoned players.

Controls:
Movement is done with the left analog stick, the camera is with the right analog stick, and finally one button to fire a weapon. 

All other main actions? 
Well, there are no other main actions for the players to input!

Simplicity is key, and we want the player to just be able to whip this game out with some buddies. But just because it is simple doesn't mean that the challenges will be easy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Easy to learn, hard to master, controls are simple to understand for veterans and newcomers.  Socializing with others in different ways such as 4 player splitscreen, LAN play with split screen, or online with split screen.  Combines an old school 3d platformer with the thrill of a party shooter.
